# Skill: UI Visual

Goal: make the product feel like a calm premium B2B/fintech workspace.

Checks:
1. Read the existing design tokens before changing components.
2. No glassmorphism, aurora, decorative gradients, excessive blur, giant shadows or visual noise.
3. Use semantic tokens for surfaces, text, borders, accent, success and danger.
4. Preserve hierarchy: page title → context → primary action → content.
5. Cards use consistent radius, border and shadow; tables use aligned numeric columns.
6. Focus states must be visible; icon-only buttons need aria-label/title.
7. Light/dark/system themes must keep readable contrast.
8. Mobile layouts must not overflow horizontally.
9. Never solve a styling issue by hiding broken content or replacing real data with placeholders.

Deliverable: identify selector/component, visual cause, concrete fix, and responsive impact.
